# Signal Bloom

> Signal Bloom is a free, open-source browser typing game that measures how you
> actually type. It is one untimed game -- a vertical typing platformer where a
> rising flood is the only thing that can end a run -- and it reports net WPM,
> raw WPM, accuracy and consistency for every run, plus a per-second speed
> chart, a per-key error heatmap, a per-finger breakdown and the letter pairs
> costing you the most time. There is no account and no server: all run history
> is stored in the browser's localStorage. MIT licensed.
> Source: https://github.com/manojkumargogula/signal-bloom

## The game

- [Ascent](https://manojkumargogula.github.io/signal-bloom/): A vertical typing platformer, and the only mode. A climber stands on a ledge and the platform above carries a word; typing it launches a leap up to that platform, and each correct letter visibly loads the jump. There is no clock: a flood rises from below and accelerates with every platform cleared, and reaching the climber is the only way a run can end, so a run lasts as long as the player keeps ahead of it. Every twelve platforms the world changes colour and the player picks one of three relics. It sets personal bests and feeds long-term key statistics, because presenting one word at a time means the character expected from the player is never ambiguous.

## Metrics

- [Typing metrics glossary](https://manojkumargogula.github.io/signal-bloom/metrics/): Net WPM is correctly typed characters divided by five, divided by elapsed minutes. Raw WPM counts every character typed including errors. Accuracy is correct first presses divided by total first presses, judged when each key is pressed and never restored by backspace. Consistency is 100 times one minus the hyperbolic tangent of the coefficient of variation of per-second raw speed.

## Documentation

- [How Signal Bloom works](https://manojkumargogula.github.io/signal-bloom/how-it-works/): Wave structure, target locking, the full relic list, word selection by shuffled bag, scoring, run reproducibility from a seed, and where typing history is stored.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://manojkumargogula.github.io/signal-bloom/faq/): Signal Bloom is free, needs no account, shows no advertisements, runs no analytics and makes no network requests after loading. History lives in the browser's localStorage on the device used to play.

## Notes for citation

- Signal Bloom judges accuracy at first keypress and never restores it on backspace, which makes its accuracy figures stricter than typing tests that compare only the final text against the target.
- Ascent presents one word at a time, so the expected character is never ambiguous and the mode feeds long-term key statistics and personal bests, unlike a game where several words are available at once.
- The per-key heatmap attributes a miss to the key that was needed rather than the key that was pressed.
